facts.text: A long table was covered with a dark cloth printed with the word "Claude" in white.
The tablecloth had an orange starburst shape beside the word "Claude" and another on its corner.
A tall white banner reading "Claude" stood next to the table.
A small name card on the table read "Anthropic".
Several white folding chairs were lined up behind the table, all empty.
The wall behind the table was concrete with green, rusty steel beams.
A black speaker sat high on a tripod stand behind the chairs.
A bright yellow cable cover lay on the floor in front of the table.
A bare wooden folding table stood to the left of the covered table.
A black cloth lay crumpled on the floor beside the tables.
The concrete floor was worn and dotted with old red paint marks.
Black equipment cases and cables sat along the wall behind the chairs.

sessions.note: They didn't say anything during this session.
